verdict.rationale: Supabase provides database/backend infrastructure, an MCP server, and Edge Functions/CLI that AI assistants or agents can call, but there is no evidence of a scheduling or automation-orchestration feature that lets users set up tasks to run autonomously in the background (e.g., cron jobs, triggers-as-automations, workflow scheduling). Edge Functions and Realtime are reactive/on-demand, not autonomous background automation.
